retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome band portrait with a vibrant magenta duotone wash and soft, airbrushed psychedelic halos.
excludeWhen: modern clean sans-serif aesthetics are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a high-contrast black and white photograph of a group, integrated with a soft magenta airbrushed aura and bold, rounded display typography against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject figures anchored to a diagonal architectural line
Magenta glow echoing the silhouettes of the subjects
Bold title text balanced in the upper right quadrant
High-contrast black shadows against a blown-out white environment
coreInvariants: Magenta as the primary spot color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged along a rising diagonal slope from left to center-right, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The diagonal white ledge or wall that supports the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the bottom-left figures, follows the diagonal upward to the right, and settles on the large title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the upper left and bottom right, creating a clean, airy feel despite the psychedelic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta (typography fill, airbrushed halos, and logo)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white background with high-saturation magenta accents and low-value black shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, heavy-weight serif with soft terminals
letterConstructionRules: Soft, rounded corners on all terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a large, circular counter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair bold display bubble fonts with small, clean sans-serif technical metadata in the corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, 70s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides a similar weight and vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of four people sitting on a white diagonal ledge against a white background. Apply a soft magenta airbrush glow behind their heads and shoulders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, rounded magenta title text in the upper right. Add small technical text and a small magenta logo in the top right and bottom left corners respectively.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta glow soft and diffused?
Is the photography high-contrast black and white?
Is the background predominantly white negative space?
Is the font heavy and rounded?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the photo
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original band members

avoid: Jagged edges on the magenta glow

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the magenta color is vibrant and consistent.
Check that the text is legible against the white background.
Verify the diagonal composition creates a sense of upward movement.
Confirm the photographic subjects are rendered in high-contrast B&W.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photo + Magenta airbrush aura + Bold rounded typography + Minimalist white layout.
